dataset.name: Groundsource: A Dataset of Flood Events from News

method.intersection: ST_Intersects between event WKB geometry and HydroBASINS level-8 catchment polygon (DuckDB spatial)
method.tiers: local: event area ≤ 5× catchment area and ≥30% of the event lies inside the catchment; regional: otherwise
method.deduplication: reports of the same tier with overlapping or adjacent (±1 day) date windows are merged; all source uuids retained
method.negatives: NOT generated. Days without a report are unlabeled, not negative. News coverage bias is unquantified.
